cause.what_happened: At 09:05 ET the company filed an 8-K (items 1.01/9.01). It says the $24.0M Reg S private placement signed 2026-09-08 (20,338,974 shares at about $1.18) missed its 2026-09-29 outside date. The deadline is now 2026-10-16, and closing is deferred until the company 'has received the Subscription Amounts'. The stock opened +2.1%, traded between $3.05 and $2.26, and was -17.9% at the 15:04 screen. This was the third straight double-digit fall after a roughly 249% September run.

findings.finding: A large, unlocked supply overhang can be sold into any bounce on 2026-10-01. The resale prospectus (424B3, effective 2026-08-25) registers about 58.9M shares for eight Chinese-named holders with no lock-up. 20M of those were bought at $0.60 in the June PIPE (about 3.9x cost at $2.34) and 38.9M are Sino Lion's converted preferred. On top of that there is a live $100M H.C. Wainwright ATM, with no sales as of 2026-09-04.
findings.mechanism_in_window: Both registrations are effective today. The resale S-3 went effective on 2026-08-25 and the ATM prospectus supplement is dated 2026-08-31, amended 2026-09-04. Holders or the issuer can sell on 2026-10-01 without filing anything new. That is the brief's 'open ATM that can be drawn tonight' case, and it is large: 58.9M resale shares against about 38.6M non-affiliate float. The PIPE funding gap disclosed today also gives the issuer a reason to use the ATM for cash.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No dated ATM-sale or resale-sale disclosure exists to measure against. The next 10-Q would show ATM usage and is outside the window. The baseline's own falls after the supply became effective (from 2026-08-25): 2026-09-21 +29.13%, 2026-09-28 -13.37%, 2026-09-29 -17.90% the next session. That is mixed, and the last two continued.
findings.why_not_priced: The close prices today's news, the PIPE delay. It does not price the certainty that any recovery on 10-01 meets sellers who own at $0.60 and are free to sell. If the overhang were fully priced, the stock would already trade near where the resale holders stop selling. Instead it is still about 2x the June PIPE's cost basis, and resale supply of about 1.5x the public float is registered.

outside_window.finding: The $24.0M Reg S PIPE (20.3M shares at about $1.18) has not been funded. The company says it is waiting on subscription amounts, even though the deal is about 100% in the money at $2.34. Failure to fund would mean losing $24M of runway: the company has had going-concern language since the 2026-08-13 release and no active clinical program. Closing would remove the doubt, but the shares are restricted for 6 months, so there is no near-term supply. The outcome can land on any day up to the 2026-10-16 outside date. Nothing dates it to 2026-10-01.

Going-concern ('substantial doubt') language in the Q2 release, with no active clinical program after Decoy20 enrollment was discontinued. The strategy pivot to a preclinical sleep neurotech device depends on the PIPE cash.
The Reg S PIPE shares carry a 6-month resale restriction and a resale-registration obligation. They are a supply release about six months after closing, which is at the earliest 2027-Q1.
